calendar_timing_override.retrieval_method: Web search tool open parsed the full primary PDF notice; original PDF bytes were not downloaded or retained
calendar_timing_override.exact_excerpt: RTH trading from 9:30 a.m. to 1:15 p.m.
calendar_timing_override.applicability: C1 SPX, VIX and XSP options, July3; notice specifies ET
calendar_timing_override.interpretation: Regular options session ended17:15UTC. This corrects the XCBF package proxy for the eligibility gate only; it does not certify the exact timestamp of Yahoo VIX daily close.

independent_treasury_request.retention: Only observation rows throughJuly30 retained; later annual-response rows discarded

limitations: Current-vintage historical data can contain corrections; original unrevised publication vintage is not certified.
The sanitized retained Yahoo responses are explicit derivatives of network responses; original network SHA256 and retained-byte SHA256 are separately recorded.
Later split-event metadata is used solely to restore historical share units. No later price arrays or current price metadata enter retained inputs.

Independent calendar gates certify completed daily-session eligibility. Exact Yahoo print timestamps are not certified; Cboe July3 source describes options regular-session hours, not a separately certified VIX daily-print timestamp.
Futures/DXY use bounded vendor observations rather than an independently acquired settlement tape.
This receipt covers infrastructure only; every authored numeric and factual claim still needs own-date editorial review.
